import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static int yearUniversityAdmission(int n, int[] array) {
        int sum = 0;
        for (int x : array) {
            sum += x;
        }
        return sum / n;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int[] years = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            years[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }
        System.out.println(yearUniversityAdmission(n, years));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
